en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5606 - Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Abi Nasr narrated from Al-Hasan bin Musa Al-Hannat, from Al-Fudhayl bin Yasar, who said:
I heard Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) say:

"By Allah (swt), neither Al-Abbas nor Ali (as) inherited from the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family). None inherited from him except Sayyida Fatimah {s.a} (peace be upon her).
And Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) only took the weapons and other items because He (as) had settled his (the Prophet's (sw)) debts."
Then Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) recited the verse of Allah (swt);

"And the blood relatives are nearer to each other in the Book of Allah (swt)."
(Surah Al-Ahzab 33:6)
